note: Silhouette scores compare visible boundaries only, not internal geometry, wood, lighting or unseen surfaces. Original is authoritative.

internal_features.inspection: Original and selected source overlays and head close-ups checked against neutral render; topology and cavity depth independently validated.
internal_features.mitre: One continuous rounded meridian from the collar transition to the finial, replacing the previous shelf and cylindrical skirt; full-thickness oblique cut and solid floor preserved.
internal_features.collars: Three descending collar steps, preserved by profile comparison.
internal_features.lower_body: Concave stem, raised socket lip, flared base and rounded flat-bottom foot preserved.
internal_features.limits: Wood and lighting are not reconstructed. Single-view evidence cannot determine hidden geometry uniquely.
